subject: City Record Agency Rules multi-notice rulemaking stitch after lookback widen + generic-ref false-merge hotfix

lookback.prior_false_merge_note: v4 after lookback widen over-stitched via generic Title-N / bare 'sections' tokens (e.g. demo #notice/20260714029 listed bicycle racks, truck routes, FY agenda as siblings under rulemaking:dot:ref:sections). False-merge proxy then only scored title_agency_window cohesion and under-counted shared_reference clusters.
lookback.note: Prior 14-day materialization almost never co-located proposal/hearing/adoption siblings; multi_notice_rulemakings stayed 0 on live. v5 demotes generic refs and requires title-core floor for shared_reference.

sample.source: SODA dg92-zbpx Agency Rules + NYC Rules RSS (50-item feed) for summary refs

false_merge.definition: Multi-notice group under ANY method (including shared_reference) whose mean pairwise title-core overlap is below RULEMAKING_TITLE_OVERLAP_MIN (0.55), or size>8 with pair-match density < 0.85. Helper: measureRulemakingSiblingFalseMerge. Prior receipt used a title-core proxy that missed shared_reference chain-merges.
false_merge.verdict: Low false-merge rate under the tightened proxy; residual cluster is DSNY commercial-waste phased program notices (title_agency_window), not generic Title-N/ref:sections. Demo FHV parking no longer absorbs unrelated DOT rulemakings.

fhv_commercial_meters_20260714029.note: Documented demo rules-lifecycle-spine. After hotfix: singleton (no false siblings). Must not be rulemaking:dot:ref:sections with bicycle racks / truck routes / FY agenda.

bicycle_racks_proposal_adoption.note: Genuine City-Owned Bicycle Racks siblings still stitch (title-core); not merged into FHV parking.

restaurant_vs_car_wash_must_not_merge.basis: title-core overlap too low (0%) or missing dates

title_1_dob_boilerplate_must_not_merge.basis: bare Title 1 / non-numeric sections not emitted; no title-core floor

exact_section_4_01_without_title_core_mu.basis: shared 34 RCNY §4-01 alone is not high confidence without title-core (FHV parking vs bicycle racks)
